title: Smart112Dispatch
description: Contract schema for authoritative emergency unit dispatch execution and tracking.

dispatch_id.description: Unique UUID for this dispatch transaction.

incident_id.description: UUID of the incident to which the unit is assigned.

unit_id.description: Authoritative identifier of the dispatched response unit.

dispatcher_id.description: Unique identifier of the authenticated human dispatcher authorizing this deployment.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of dispatch issuance.

status.description: Current real-time operational status of the dispatched unit.

priority_override.description: Indicates whether dispatcher escalated priority above AI recommendation.

dispatch_channel.description: Primary communication channel over which dispatch order was relayed.

special_dispatch_notes.description: Tactical notes, entry instructions, or safety warnings relayed to the responding crew.

acknowledged_at.description: Timestamp when responding crew acknowledged receipt on MDT or radio.

on_scene_at.description: Timestamp when unit confirmed arrival at incident coordinates.

cleared_at.description: Timestamp when unit completed assignment and returned to service.
